data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 649.0m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows effectively no net prior-year movement for underwriting years 2018-2020 (net prior year development  GBP 0.0m). The 2019 and prior years had experienced favourable development of GBP 9.9m prior to those years being transferred via a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) to Riverstone in 2022, and the LPT / reinsurance-to-close transactions materially affect comparability. Named catastrophe events in 2022 (e.g. Hurricane Ian, Winter storm Elliott) and prior years (e.g. Winterstorm Uri, Hurricane Ida, and COVID-19 event cancellation losses) influenced claims development, but the net published prior-year movement is neutral after accounting for transfers.
raw_causal_phrases: experienced favourable development of GBP 9.9m prior to entering into a LPT with Riverstone Syndicate 3500 during 2022.
entered into a loss portfolio transaction covering the underwriting years 2018 and 2019.
the 2020 year of account was impacted materially by Covid-19 losses in our event cancellation business and also materially impacted by Winterstorm Uri and Hurricane Ida.

The loss portfolio transfer (LPT) of the 2019 and 2018 years of account which was followed by an external RITC of 2020 and prior years to Riverstone Managing Agency Ltd, provides a clean break with the past and enables management attention to be devoted to the current portfolio.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: the claims development triangle indicates no net movement for underwriting years 2018-2020 (calculated from the triangle). However, the report also states that 2019 and prior experienced a favourable development of GBP 9.9m prior to a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) to Riverstone, and an RITC/LPT in 2022 materially alters comparability of prior year reserves. Where narrative and triangle differ, the triangle (gross) was used. No explicit standalone 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was presented that unambiguously covered all prior years after the LPT; therefore triangle-derived result is returned (0.0).
